about_the_game:
Deskie: Your AI Desktop Companion

🏠 Bring companionship onto your desktop

Deskie isn’t just a chat window trapped in the corner, nor a cold, isolated app. It’s a little companion that feels alive — living right on your desktop, breathing, thinking, reacting warmly, and understanding what companionship really means.

You can poke it anytime, chat with it through text or voice, ask it for a story, vent your feelings, or let it quietly keep you company. It understands multiple languages and replies with a vivid original voice. Its facial expressions, movements, and even lip sync match its speech—just like a real friend talking to you in person.

Even better, characters have long-term memory. As you spend more time together, it gradually remembers your preferences and past conversations. Your interactions never “reset”—it just understands you more and more, making every moment feel warm and naturally connected.

🚀 A vibrant and expressive character library

Our character library is not just a lineup of cardboard cutouts—it’s a whole crew of lively little gremlins brought to life with high-fidelity Live2D magic! They can act cute, interact freely on your desktop, and even look adorable while spacing out. It’s like pulling your favorite anime buddies straight into your monitor!

Each character comes with its own quirks and backstory waiting for you to discover. And the best part? Our team and talented community creators are constantly “adopting” new cuties, making sure your desktop always feels like a never-ending fun-filled party!

✨ Customize your own special character

Want a desktop buddy that’s truly one of a kind? The door to creative customization is always wide open! From dialogue style to voice tone, from personality settings to story prompts—you control every detail. You can use tons of available models, or drag your own Live2D/3D OC straight onto your desktop.

Plus, there’s a huge voice library ready to melt your ears. And when you’ve created the ultimate masterpiece, you can share it with the whole community for tons of praise—or keep it private just for yourself and close friends.

🧡 Enjoy free daily credits

To let more people experience the vision of Deskie early:

🎁 Receive free usage credits every day during public testing

🎁 AI chat and voice interaction available daily for free

🎁 Character downloads, creation, editing, and publishing — all free

Whether you are grinding games or just spacing out, she remembers your chats and offers a comforting presence.
